environment: Local synthetic account on a real PostgreSQL database with migrations 001 through 004 applied.

assertions.claim: A current capture creates one general source resource and one typed evidence fragment per reviewed message.
Manual source deletion records both new derivative types in lineage.
Deletion removes source locator and evidence text while preserving non-content tombstones for audit.

limits: This bridge covers the current message-shaped screenshot and transcript path; resume pages, document regions, and URL excerpts are not yet executable.
No Wiki snapshot existed in this case, so downstream Wiki and Chat invalidation is not proven.
